_doc: THE BLACKOUT (user 2026-09-25: the map 'should be really dark ... the only thing that you can see pretty well is maybe the sky, and once power's on things will light up'; 'remove the glow everywhere'). One no-glow clone per vertigo pack material: tod_black_<suffix> = the donor with scaleRGB 0 (no emission), the mirror zeroed, albedo = the donor's line hue x albedo. Read by tools/gen_tod_door_materials.js (writes the GDT blocks) AND tools/gen_tower_map.js (BLACKOUT remaps every face to them) AND tools/lint_tod_geometry.js (tod_black_X takes X's DECK/BLOCK class). One list, three readers: a name here is always generated, remapped and classed.
